crash.description: It left a crash report on this computer. You can export diagnostics, without private details, to attach to a bug report.
crash.title: Arden Code closed unexpectedly

ARD-AGT-001.action: Start a new session with New session.
ARD-AGT-001.what: That session does not exist any more.
ARD-AGT-001.why: It was deleted, or the file it was kept in could not be read.

ARD-AGT-002.action: Wait for the reply to finish, or stop it with Esc, then send your message again.
ARD-AGT-002.why: The agent is still answering the last message.

ARD-AGT-003.action: Your sessions keep working until Arden Code closes. Free some space or check the folder, then restart Arden Code.
ARD-AGT-003.what: Your sessions are not being saved.
ARD-AGT-003.why: Arden Code could not write to its sessions file. The disk may be full, or the folder may be read-only.

ARD-AGT-004.action: The old file was kept next to the new one as sessions.invalid-<date>.db, in Arden Code's local data folder.
ARD-AGT-004.what: Your saved sessions could not be read, so Arden Code started without them.
ARD-AGT-004.why: The sessions file was damaged, or it was made by a newer version of Arden Code.

ARD-AGT-005.action: Unarchive the session to carry on with it, or start a linked session from it.
ARD-AGT-005.why: An archived session is put away and kept as it was: it takes no new messages, names or pins.

ARD-AGT-006.action: Write a name of 1 to 100 characters, then save it again.
ARD-AGT-006.why: A session's name needs 1 to 100 characters, not counting spaces at either end.

ARD-AGT-007.action: Install Claude Code (Settings → Agents shows how), then send your message again.
ARD-AGT-007.why: Claude works through Claude Code, Anthropic's own program, and Arden Code could not find claude on this computer.

ARD-AGT-008.action: Open a terminal and run claude update, then send your message again.
ARD-AGT-008.why: Arden Code needs Claude Code 2.1.223 or later, and an older version is installed.

ARD-AGT-009.action: Open a terminal, run claude, sign in with /login, then send your message again.
ARD-AGT-009.what: Claude Code is not signed in.
ARD-AGT-009.why: Claude Code signs in on its own, with your Claude account or your API key. Arden Code never signs in for you.

ARD-AGT-010.action: Send your message again. If it keeps happening, check that claude runs in a terminal, and look at its log in Settings → Advanced → Open logs.
ARD-AGT-010.why: The program could not be started, or it ended before it finished the reply.

ARD-AGT-011.action: Update Arden Code and Claude Code (claude update), then send your message again.
ARD-AGT-011.what: Arden Code could not talk to Claude Code.
ARD-AGT-011.why: Claude Code did not answer the way Arden Code expects. It may be a version Arden Code does not know yet.

ARD-AGT-012.action: Install Claude Code with its native installer (Settings → Agents shows how), then send your message again.
ARD-AGT-012.what: Arden Code cannot start this installation of Claude Code safely.
ARD-AGT-012.why: Only npm's claude.cmd was found, and Windows would read a message passed to it as commands.

ARD-AGT-013.action: Read Claude Code's reason, then send your message again when it is solved.
ARD-AGT-013.why: Claude Code reported a problem, such as a usage limit, an overloaded service or a billing issue. Its own words are under this message.

ARD-AGT-014.action: Start a new session to work with another agent or in another project.
ARD-AGT-014.what: The agent and the project of this session cannot change any more.
ARD-AGT-014.why: A session keeps the agent and the project of its first message.

ARD-AGT-015.action: Nothing to do: the reply already went on without this answer.
ARD-AGT-015.what: That request no longer waits for an answer.
ARD-AGT-015.why: The reply stopped, or Claude Code stopped asking, before the answer arrived.

ARD-AGT-016.action: Send the message again and choose Trust folder, if you trust what is in it.
ARD-AGT-016.what: Claude cannot work in this folder until you trust it.
ARD-AGT-016.why: Claude Code runs a project's own hooks, MCP servers and environment settings without asking.

ARD-APP-001.action: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the details and report it.
ARD-APP-001.what: Something unexpected went wrong inside Arden Code.
ARD-APP-001.why: This is a bug in Arden Code, not something you did.

ARD-APP-002.action: Reload the window. If it keeps happening, copy the details and report it.
ARD-APP-002.what: The interface hit an error it could not handle.
ARD-APP-002.why: A part of the screen failed to draw or to respond.

ARD-APP-003.action: Try again. If it keeps happening, delete the folders named io.github.valasme.arden in %APPDATA% and %LOCALAPPDATA% yourself.
ARD-APP-003.what: Arden Code could not get ready to reset itself.
ARD-APP-003.why: The file that asks for the reset could not be written.

ARD-APP-004.action: Copy the address and open it yourself if you trust it.
ARD-APP-004.why: Arden Code does not open some kinds of link, such as programs and scripts, or Windows could not open it.

ARD-APP-005.action: Check that notifications are allowed for Arden Code in Windows settings, and that Focus assist is off.

ARD-APP-006.action: Close any program that may be using Arden Code's folders, such as an Explorer window or a terminal, then restart Arden Code to finish the reset.
ARD-APP-006.what: Arden Code could not finish resetting itself.
ARD-APP-006.why: Some of its files could not be deleted, usually because another program had them open. Your settings were kept.

ARD-LOG-001.action: Open it yourself in Explorer, at %LOCALAPPDATA%\io.github.valasme.arden\logs.
ARD-LOG-001.what: The logs folder could not be opened.
ARD-LOG-001.why: Windows refused, or the folder could not be created.

ARD-LOG-002.action: Choose another folder, and check that it is writable.
ARD-LOG-002.what: The diagnostics could not be saved.
ARD-LOG-002.why: The file could not be written. The folder may be read-only, or the disk full.

ARD-PROC-001.action: Restart Arden Code. If it keeps happening, report it.
ARD-PROC-001.what: Arden Code cannot start other programs on this computer.
ARD-PROC-001.why: Windows did not let it make the group that keeps agent programs together with the app.

ARD-SET-001.action: Check that the folder is writable, then change the setting again.
ARD-SET-001.what: Your settings could not be saved.
ARD-SET-001.why: The settings file could not be written. The disk may be full, or the file may be locked by another program.

ARD-SET-002.action: Your old file was kept next to it as settings.invalid-<date>.json. Fix it there and copy it back, or keep the defaults.
ARD-SET-002.what: The settings file was not valid, so the default settings are in use.
ARD-SET-002.why: The file was damaged, or it was edited into something Arden Code cannot read.

ARD-SET-003.action: Choose a file that was exported from Arden Code, or fix the file and try again. Your current settings were not changed.
ARD-SET-003.what: That settings file could not be imported.
ARD-SET-003.why: The file is not valid JSON, or a setting in it has a value that is not allowed.

ARD-SET-004.action: Choose another folder, and check that it is writable.
ARD-SET-004.what: Your settings could not be exported.
ARD-SET-004.why: The file could not be written. The folder may be read-only, or the disk full.

ARD-SET-005.action: Open it yourself in Explorer, at %APPDATA%\io.github.valasme.arden\settings.json.
ARD-SET-005.why: Windows refused, or no program is set to open JSON files.

ARD-UPD-001.action: Try again. If it keeps happening, download the newest version from the releases page.
ARD-UPD-001.what: The update could not be installed.
ARD-UPD-001.why: The installer did not start, or it was stopped.

ARD-WIN-001.action: Use the buttons at the right of the title bar instead.
ARD-WIN-001.what: Windows' window menu could not be opened.
ARD-WIN-001.why: Windows did not accept the request.

ARD-WIN-002.action: Your work is not lost. If it keeps happening, turn off hardware acceleration in Settings → Advanced, and report it.
ARD-WIN-002.what: The part of Arden Code that draws the window stopped, and was started again.
ARD-WIN-002.why: Its process crashed or stopped answering. A graphics driver problem is the usual cause.
